titulo: Suspected ShinyHunters leader arrested in the Netherlands
cuerpo: Dutch police say they arrested a 24-year-old Amsterdam man in connection with ShinyHunters, the hacking group that claimed responsibility for high-profile attacks on Ticketmaster, Rockstar Games, and more recently, the FBI.
